name: BNBX
rootCause: The victim contract exposes a dangerous function (0x11834d4c) that allows any external user to drain the full token balance (BNBX) of any address that has granted an allowance to the contract. This occurs due to a complete lack of access control or sender validation on a transferFrom call. Vulnerable code snippet: Attack tx: https://bscscan.com/address/0x389a9ae29fbe53cca7bc8b7a4d9d0a04078e1c24 Analysis: The function 0x11834d4c executes the following logic: 1. Reads the BNBXtoken balance of an arbitrary address varg0. 2. Transfers the entire balance from varg0 to msg.sender using transferFrom. There are no checks to ensure: - That msg.sender is authorized to perform the action. Since the attacker can repeatedly call 0x11834d4c to use up the allowance of all victim users.

BNBX was exploited on BNB Chain on 27 April 2024 due to an arithmetic error in share accounting. The attacker drained user balances by exploiting incorrect share-value tracking, extracting value via PancakeSwap. The estimated loss is about 75 BNB; USD impact is unconfirmed. An arithmetic error in the BNBX token contract's share-to-value accounting enabled withdrawals that did not properly reflect actual reserves, allowing an attacker to drain user funds.
